sloka: ततः सस्त्रीपुमांसस्ते सपक्षिपशुवाहनाः ।राघवस्यानुगाः सर्वे हृष्टा विगतकल्मषाः ।। ७.१०९.१५ ॥
transliteration: tataḥ sastrīpumāṁsaste sapakṣipaśuvāhanāḥ ।rāghavasyānugāḥ sarve hṛṣṭā vigatakalmaṣāḥ ।। 7.109.15 ॥

translations.english: Then, all of Rama's followers, including men, women, birds, animals, and those with vehicles, were joyful and purified of all sins.
